notes: AI5WIN (elf/Silky's lineage): AI5WIN.exe is the engine's FIXED runtime executable name -- hook tables key on exactly that process name (https://github.com/HIllya51/LunaTranslator/blob/main/src/NativeImpl/LunaHook/LunaHook/engine32/Elf.cpp) -- paired with the engine's .arc archives, per the brief's rule that an .exe name is never evidence on its own. .gcc images (G24n/G24m/R24n/R24m) are AI5WIN-only in GARbro (https://morkt.github.io/GARbro/supported.html).
